sections.section_title: SYSCFG VDDIO2 compensation cell status register (SYSCFG_VDDIO2CCSR)
sections.text_helper: Section 16.1.19 "SYSCFG VDDIO2 compensation cell status register (SYSCFG_VDDIO2CCSR)" in chapter 16 (System configuration controller (SYSCFG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 820.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x058
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Reset by system reset.
Bits 31:9 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 8 READY: Provides the compensation cell status of I/Os supplied by VDDIO2
0: VDDIO2 I/O compensation cell not ready
1: VDDIO2 I/O compensation cell ready
Bits 7:4 APSRC[3:0]: This value is provided by the cell, and can be used by the CPU to compute an I/O
compensation cell code for PMOS transistors.
This code is applied to the I/O compensation cell when CS = 0 inSYSCFG_VDDIO2CCCR,
and READY = 1 in this register.
Bits 3:0 ANSRC[3:0]: This value is provided by the cell, and can be used by the CPU to compute an I/O
compensation cell code for NMOS transistors.
This code is applied to the I/O compensation cell when CS = 0 inSYSCFG_VDDIO2CCCR,
and READY = 1 in this register.
